name: MOO_IMP_REVN_LINE_SET
description: This table is the interface table to MOO_REVN. It stores information for tracking revenue line set.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: links this row with the rows in the errors table

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: status of the import row

columns.name: REVN_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Stores the create date of the revenue record.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: REVN_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the revenue

columns.name: REVN_NUMBER
columns.description: User editable revenue number. Defaulted from REVN_ID. Needs to be unique. Cannot be null

columns.name: OPTY_ID
columns.description: Opportunity ID

columns.name: OPTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Opportunity Number. This is a public surrogate key.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if the record is meant for insert, update, or delete.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: System determined action code

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: FILE_RECORD_NUM

columns.name: CUST_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Target party id (customer or prospect)

columns.name: CUST_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number for this customer party

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System ID for the customer party

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the customer party

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Customer account ID

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number for this customer account

columns.name: CUST_ACT_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Unique identification number for this customer account

columns.name: CUST_ACT_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the customer account

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Business Unit ID, derived from oppty

columns.name: REVN_AMT_CURCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for all monetary amounts except Predicted Revenue

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Opportunity revenue line set-enabled product group

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: used to retrieve prod_group_id from QSC_PROD_GROUP_B when it's not supplied

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: Product group internal name, when prod_group_id is not populated, this column is used to get prod_group_id from QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B(_TL)

columns.name: INTERNAL_OPTY_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the Opportunity record which will be affected by this instruction.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record being updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.
